verdict.rationale: Rippling IT includes an IdP (apps, groups, access rules), so identity-as-code is a fair question for it. The evidence documents only a v2 REST API, an npm SDK, and an MCP server. These are developer building blocks, and nothing shows an official Terraform provider or other declarative, reviewable configuration covering apps, groups, and policies.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, the IdP is managed as code — an official Terraform provider (or equivalent) covers apps, groups, and policies so identity config is reviewable and reproducible
